title: The kb-sprint run step orders runs --reconcile before the review and gives the Bash timeout its 540-second wait needs
goal: the run step orders `backlog.py runs SP --reconcile` before the review (release and a done without a landing move no run state) and gives the Bash timeout 600000 that its wait of S 540 needs

run:
import os, re, shlex, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
R = os.getcwd()
text = open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
m = re.search(r'\n## run \[SP\]\n(.*?)\n## review SP\n', text, re.S)
run = m.group(1) if m else ''
bad = []
cmds = [c for c in re.findall(r'`([^`\n]+)`', run) if re.search(r'backlog\.py runs\b[^`\n]*--reconcile', c)]
if not cmds:
    bad.append('the run step gives no backlog.py runs SP --reconcile command before the sprint ends')
else:
    T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
    env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
    def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
    g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
    shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
    sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, 'new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
    argv = shlex.split(cmds[0].replace('${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}', R))
    at = next(i for i, a in enumerate(argv) if a.endswith('backlog.py'))
    argv[at + 1:at + 1] = ['--root', T]
    r = sh(*[sp if a == 'SP' else a for a in argv])
    if r.returncode != 0:
        bad.append('the runs --reconcile command of the run step exits %d: %s' % (r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-160:]))
if not re.search(r'timeout[^\n]{0,40}600000', run[run.find('coord.py wait'):][:1500] if 'coord.py wait' in run else ''):
    bad.append('the wait paragraph does not give the Bash timeout 600000 its S 540 relies on')
print('; '.join(bad) or 'ok')
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: Found by the review of SP-hja7yu5k (SKILL.md:56): 'runs SP shows no drift line at the sprint's end' is false after a release or a story finished with done (BG fix pending); until then the run step needs `runs SP --reconcile`. The wait paragraph says S 540 ends under the Bash tool's 10-minute limit but not to pass timeout 600000 (the default is 120000, so a foreground wait is killed after 2 minutes; a background wait takes timeout up to 7200000).
